text_block_list.name: Opponents
text_block_list.text:
—Huh, already? You usually ask for 'just 
one more match.'

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I just can't get into the mood.

"Nakayama Festa, backing down from a 
gamble...? Perhaps the fatigue from her 
races is still lingering..."
